title: ProcessRemoteOutput
description: Output of `gentry process remote --json`: the remote repository of the process is connected and synchronized with.

result.description: sent: the remote repository was empty and got the process of this machine; received: this machine had no process and got the remote one; merged: both had one and they are brought together; unchanged: both had the same.

drafts.description: Kinds whose variant of this machine became a draft over the remote one; empty if none.
